scope: Official main BoTorch package at the pinned reference; native Rust CPU and optional Torch float32/float64 CPU/CUDA backends. Specialized models, entropy/search, device NUTS and variational pathwise updates included. Community excluded. Availability and tested configurations do not certify every subclass/configuration combination.

api_inventory.meaning: Symbol availability is not proof of numerical parity, supported configurations, autograd compatibility or performance.

native_tests.execution_revision_note: The trajectory reference-grid Python-test/documentation-only commit landed during native execution; all 300 Rust/Cargo input files remained unchanged. The successful native execution log and inventory both account for 532 tests in 46 groups.

native_quality_evidence.method: Recorded from the observed successful root tool call running Clippy, then rustfmt only after Clippy exited 0. The combined command returned exit_code=0; this recorder does not infer rustfmt success from its empty log or rerun either check.

performance.scope: interleaved shuffled warmed no_grad posterior mean+variance; CUDA synchronized before and after each timed call; excludes construction, fitting, imports, first training factor

remaining_limits: Select backend="torch" explicitly for CPU data/query/parameter higher-order graphs; native CPU float64 semantics are separate.
Dense exact Tensor algebra is used for structured Kronecker/higher-order models; structured-performance work is separate.

NUTS keeps numerical states on device but synchronizes scalar tree decisions; random/discrete choices and sampled MCMC values are detached as in standard MCMC. Arbitrary custom probabilistic overrides and eager jit_compile=True remain unsupported.
Noisy Tensor root-cache requests use an explicit exact-joint-sampling performance fallback.

General nonlinear constrained optimization and selected fitting/default optimizer interfaces use an explicit SciPy boundary; candidate vectors/objective derivatives cross that boundary while model algebra stays on device. Forced parallel SciPy mode is unsupported.
Model-specific shapes, transforms, likelihood and pathwise strategy restrictions are documented in the linked family notes.
KG evaluate holds optimized inner decisions fixed for its envelope gradient; augmented one-shot KG retains the functional graph.
The API inventory and regression suite do not establish exhaustive behavioral/GPU parity or universal speed improvements.

The separate Linux CI run validates PyTorch 2.14 CPU at test revision e5a6c0ad3da8 with runtime inputs identical to the frozen wheel. Its case counts are separate from the installed-wheel ledger; local CUDA validation uses PyTorch 2.13.

optional_dependency_tests.method: Import-blocking harness simulates absent optional dependencies; this is separate from the installed-wheel canonical ledgers and totals.

native_bo_performance.scope: 30-iteration Hartmann-6 BO, same 14-point initial design; actual default GP fitting plus LogEI optimization (10 restarts,512 raw samples) each iteration; interleaved shuffled three seeded runs after one warmup per library; one Torch/Rayon thread; native CPU float64 versus BoTorch CPU float64; trajectories may differ
